verdict.rationale: The BILL v3 API platform, which covers S&E, documents real bulk endpoints: `POST /v3/payments/bulk` pays up to 50 bills per request and `POST /v3/payments/mass` pays up to 2000 bills per request. Bulk record export is also documented. However, these bulk operations sit on the AP side; nothing shows batch actions on Spend & Expense items such as cards, budgets, transactions or reimbursements. missing for 10: bulk/batch endpoints for S&E objects (cards, budgets, users, transactions), bulk create/update beyond payments, independent or hands-on corroboration.
